scope: Six Traditional Chinese Google Play descriptions: same Easybrain, Oakever, Brainium, Andoku, Guru and GamoVation samples. Five hl=zh_TW, Andoku accessible via hl=zh-TW. Not a verified Taiwan download/search ranking; locale parameter does not establish Taiwan-exclusive copy.
method: NFC normalization, lowercase Latin letters, whitespace collapse, then exact contiguous substring counts. Chinese is not word-segmented; nested terms and single-character anchors such as 行/列 overlap and may appear in unrelated compounds. Traditional/simplified forms and synonyms are not merged. Body between 關於這個遊戲 and 更新日期, including public short description if supplied. Excludes titles, tags, reviews, images, related apps and linked sites. Literal URLs/email text inside body remain. Cache and region may differ. For Andoku, only the directly opened 526-character body was counted; the search-result body differs and was not merged. Full competitor prose not persisted.
